semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Introduction and Hierarchy Rule for Particular Conditions
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: The introductory paragraph establishing the legal hierarchy between Particular Conditions and General Conditions.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Establishes the governing principle that Particular Conditions supplement and prevail over General Conditions in case of conflict.

semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: The standalone heading marking the beginning of the Particular Conditions section.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Serves as the structural delimiter and title for the subsequent detailed provisions of the Particular Conditions.
